name: Monsoon Flooding
description: Dravyavati river rises to danger level. Zones escalate progressively over 60 seconds.

alert.title: CRITICAL: Dravyavati River Rising
alert.description: Dravyavati river water level at 87% capacity. Mansarovar area immediate evacuation ordered.

alert.title: WARNING: Pratap Nagar Flooding
alert.description: Floodwater from Dravyavati corridor reaching Pratap Nagar. Residents on ground floor must evacuate.

alert.title: WATCH: Malviya Nagar Waterlogging
alert.description: Water levels rising in Malviya Nagar near Dravyavati. Monitoring continues.

alert.title: EMERGENCY: Dravyavati Overflow Confirmed
alert.description: River has overflowed banks at 3 points. NDRF deployed. All residents must evacuate immediately.

alert.title: CRITICAL: Pratap Nagar Submerged
alert.description: Ground floor submersion reported at 45+ locations in Pratap Nagar. Rescue boats deployed.
